title: Happy Schilling and marching band photos
summary: They identify George Schilling in a photo, a marching band on a city street, and a recent yard photo with Laine on drum.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Most versatile musicians playing peppery melodies that are just dance compelling. If it's a hit, we have it.
That boy played with me too, George Schilling.
Happy Schilling. That's a marching band.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, that's when we were marching down Common Street, at least Gravy Street from uptown.
You had some young musicians, I can see, in one picture. Oh, yeah.
Oh, that was, after the bands was already organized pretty good, we got all them parade jobs, more or less. I wanted to show you, but I don't know where the pictures are.
Is that you in the back with the drum?
Yeah. It was taken in the yard a couple of years ago, right here in the yard. Oh.
